focus: Automate complete NDRRMA Setu pagination ingestion and change detection.
actions: Source watcher upgraded to discover and preserve every Setu pagination page
Setu parser added for name, age, sex, source status, locality, authority source and source date
Stable source-record identifiers exclude mutable status while retaining duplicate occurrences
Diff engine emits additions, removals and field/status changes without interpreting removal as resolution
Source fetch retries now include curl fallback for sources that fail Node fetch
safety: No source-level record is automatically merged into a unique person and no removal is interpreted as found, safe, rescued or deceased.
